rows.text: So there was an article about escorts getting rich off AI workers. A lot of the prostitutes that hang out around rationalist circles seem to simultaneously talk about how rich they are and to constantly be launching schemes to make more money and live in situations that are not commensurate with the level of claimed wealth. Maybe they're saving aggressively. But part of me just thinks they're lying. Does anyone have any verification that they're actually booking significant numbers of clients while charging 10x what other escorts are charging?
